statement: A general quintic threefold in P⁴ contains exactly 2,875 projective lines.

answer.qualification: Generic reduced zero-dimensional Fano scheme; no claim for every smooth quintic.

origin.inheritance_basis: Set n=4 and d=2n−3=5 in the exact line-count formula: 5^6[1−3·(10/25)+10·(24/625)]=2875.

notes: Generic reduced zero-dimensional Fano scheme; no claim for every smooth quintic.
